context.body: A remembered international journey becomes part of a judgment saying.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus refuses a demanded sign except Jonah’s and says the queen of the south will judge the generation because she came to hear Solomon’s wisdom.
observations.label: Jesus speaks of one greater than Solomon: action

observations.body: Solomon’s wisdom becomes a witness against those who resist a greater presence.
observations.label: Jesus speaks of one greater than Solomon: response

observations.body: queen of the south · wisdom of Solomon · greater than Solomon
observations.label: Words in Matthew 12:38–42

payload.posture: Read Matthew 12:38–42 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The comparison asserts greater significance without retelling every content of Solomon’s wisdom.
payload.title: Jesus speaks of one greater than Solomon
